symptom: The license-policy attestation reported unresolved despite documented statutory reuse of official parliamentary materials.
root_cause: The absence of a named Creative Commons or SPDX license was incorrectly treated as absence of a verifiable legal basis for reusing public-sector information.
resolution: Publish a new immutable release with cited statutory evidence, a falsifiable legal claim, a documented license-policy attestation, source attribution and a repository LICENSE file.
prevention: Treat named-license metadata and statutory permission as distinct evidence; require official legal sources, explicit limitations and preserved immutable release lineage.
